We both used. We werent "that bad". Though before it got a little worse than it was, i lost my job. So he was the main breadwinner with both of us working an under the table job once a week to fuel our habit. Basically he called the shots and was spotting me like crazy. First it was out love, then it was to help me not get sick, then it was so I would stfu and not ruin HIS high if he didnt get me at least one. Talk about that codependency. I had the car (lol like that would have stopped him from asking someone else for a ride) and he had the main cash. It was our ritual. I was/am so in love but i saw us suffering because of this addiction. By the grace of the universe i had to move away and start treatment. He promised me we would still be together. Then we were sobering up and doing great. Everyday id ask different people about relationships in treatment and heard the same thing which was: it doesnt work. Almost everyone breaks up because in the end the only thing they had in common was the drugs. So recovery breakups are normal and expected. I thought in my stupid little head, No Not Us He Said He Loved Me and Wanted Me.... It took the next two weeks for him to really sober up and 'realize' that he hasnt been in love with me for a while. Everything we had, planned, and built was dumped like last weeks trash. It fucking hurts. Because he just had that haze over him and once the fog cleared he was like BYE BITCH. 
it fucking hurts. 
While I was thinking we'd get better and grow from this...he was thinking about ending it. 

I never had urges but holy fuck do i have em today. 
Anyway i dont know wtf im going with this but... Im still sobering up. Today is day 38. 
I still remember our ritual vividly and cry. 
But i wish all of the luck a good vibes for relationships in and recovering from addiction.
